summary_ja: 居住用不動産で法的に有効な事前販売・賃貸契約があり、払込額が契約金の大半で返金不要などの要件と適格性の要件を満たすADC向けエクスポージャーは百パーセントとすることができる。
summary_en: Residential ADC lending with binding pre-sale or pre-lease contracts for which substantial non-refundable deposits have been paid, and meeting the eligibility requirements, may take 100%.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding Article, the risk weight of ADC exposures that satisfy all of the following requirements and that satisfy all of the eligibility requirements may be 100%. (i) That the real estate that is the object of the credit is real estate for residential use. (ii) That legally valid pre-sale or pre-lease contracts have been concluded for the real estate that is the object of the credit. (iii) That the amounts paid under the pre-sale or pre-lease contracts for the real estate that is the object of the credit amount to the greater part of the total contract price. (iv) That the amounts paid in the preceding item need not be refunded if the contract is cancelled.

The provisions of Article 36, paragraph (3) (excluding item (i) and the proviso to item (ii)) shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach applies the risk weight of ADC exposures under the provisions of the preceding paragraph. In this case, the term "the preceding two paragraphs" in paragraph (3) of that Article shall be read as "Article 37-4, paragraph (1)".
